ideons.name: Hunting Tendril
ideons.text: Strikes the weakest orthogonally adjacent Ally for 4 Water, gaining 2 damage each successive command. Otherwise moves one space left, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then uses Splash against the weakest Ally anywhere: starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move left, swapping past player cards and Constructs, and Splash a distant Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.

Otherwise moves one space left, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then uses Splash against the weakest Ally anywhere: starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move left, swapping past player cards and Constructs, and Splash a distant Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.

Otherwise moves one space left, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then uses Splash against the weakest Ally anywhere: starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move left, swapping past player cards and Constructs, and Splash a distant Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.

Otherwise moves one space left, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then uses Splash against the weakest Ally anywhere: starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move left, swapping past player cards and Constructs, and Splash a distant Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.

Otherwise moves one space left, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then uses Splash against the weakest Ally anywhere: starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move left, swapping past player cards and Constructs, and Splash a distant Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.

Otherwise moves one space left, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then uses Splash against the weakest Ally anywhere: starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move left, swapping past player cards and Constructs, and Splash a distant Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.

Otherwise moves one space left, swapping with player cards and whole Constructs, then uses Splash against the weakest Ally anywhere: starts at 1 Water, gains 0.5 each successive command, rounded up. Each replacement resets both attacks to their starting damage. With no Allies, Splashes the player from its column after movement (Guard only in that column or farther left; equipment also works). If it starts at the left edge, inflicts Poison 2 instead. Killing tendrils increases their replacements.

enemies.name: The Cnidarian
enemies.signature: Begins with three hunting tendrils. They strike adjacent Allies for 4 Water (+2 each successive command); otherwise move left, swapping past player cards and Constructs, and Splash a distant Ally for 1 Water (+0.5 each successive command, rounded up). Replacements start again at 4 strike / 1 Splash. Without Allies they Splash the player from their resulting column, or inflict Poison 2 instead when starting at the left edge. Deaths 1–3 replace one-for-one, 4–6 two-for-one, then three-for-one. Replacements arrive after surviving tendrils act. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Race the owner while selectively cutting aging tendrils to reset their damage. Killing every tendril makes the brood grow.
